title: Katie Harbour shares a new single, "motivation"
htmlContent:
Hamilton, Ontario-based singer and songwriter Katie Harbour shares a brand new single, "motivation," which features thoughtful melodies and effective vocal lines.

The latest single, "motivation," contains a smoothing melody from Katie that showcases the attributes of her love life. Katie Harbour said of the song, "motivation is my gratitude for finding someone who grounds me and drives me in the hardest times. I'm inspired by 90s R&B, like, Brandy and Aaliyah, and current R&B, like Jhene Aiko and Summer Walker, in my pairing simpler lyrics with more complex beats." This track "motivation" is definitely a song you song add to your playlist.
